procedure.step: Register the factory with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism. The factory must be located outside a free zone, hold a MoIAT industrial licence, and provide a MoIAT letter confirming 40% domestic value added. Registration takes about 3 working days.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: Apply for the Certificate of Origin for India through the e-service: log in to the ministry e-services portal, choose the Certificate of Origin for India service, fill in the application form, upload proof of factory registration and the commercial invoice (and the factory's purchase invoice if a trading exporter), pay the fee online, and submit the application. Processing takes about one working day.
Pay the certificate fee: AED 10 to AED 200 depending on the invoice value in AED.

Ship the goods directly from the UAE to India. Transit through another country is allowed only under customs control with no operations other than unloading, reloading, storage or similar. If the invoice is issued by a third party, the exporter must indicate 'third-party invoicing'.

The Indian importer claims the CEPA rate when filing the bill of entry and must hold origin information including which origin criterion is claimed. Supporting documents must be kept for at least 5 years from filing and the importer must answer a customs request within 10 working days.
The exporter keeps origin records including the cost breakdown for at least 5 years, starting from the end of the calendar year of the certificate's issue.

caveats.note: The CEPA rate on this line is 12.5%, not 0%. The CEPA lowers the duty but does not remove it.
'Direct labour cost' and 'direct overhead cost' are not defined in the agreement.
The agreement does not say whether the build-down and build-up methods use the same threshold, apart from the 5-point Ex-Works adjustment.
On an Ex-Works basis the threshold is 5 percentage points lower.

No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.

A producer in a free zone is likely not eligible for Factory Registration, because it requires a factory outside a free zone, and registration is needed before applying for the certificate of origin for India.
UAE law sets a 3-year record-keeping minimum, but the CEPA's 5 years governs CEPA claims.
